rationale: The plan correctly identifies this as an interaction question, fits one full factorial model (~genotype+treatment+genotype:treatment), extracts the interaction coefficient as primary with simple effects derived by contrast (not refitting), and adds an LRT cross-check and explicit power/discordance audit against the 'compare two DE lists' fallacy. QC (PCA, distances, size factors, dispersion) precedes the model on raw counts fed to DESeq2 with explicit reference levels and no pre-normalization, and BH FDR with apeglm/ashr shrinkage clearly labeled vs unshrunken is well specified. The low-count filter (10 counts in ≥4 samples) is minimal and justified by smallest-group size, though slightly more elaboration on alternative thresholds would help. Enrichment is warranted here and is done properly (ranked by Wald stat, human symbol sets, size window, BH per collection, match-rate flagging), losing only a touch for complexity/scope creep across many collections; the report is exhaustive on method, versions-adjacent packages, design, thresholds, and caveats.
